nodes.title: About Us
nodes.body:
Hi, My name is Walter Ihring

I devote my time to animated humour and caricatures. I like travelling, especially across India. My pictures also like travelling, especially for exhibitions in cities far away.

On their return, they sometimes bring me an award as a souvenir from the competitions they had visited. On one hot day in summer, I was sipping my coffee in the square and observing the tourists as they were racing from the town hall to the cathedral, from the cathedral to the ancient fountain in order to quench their thirst for information.

Hunting for the stories of the people who lived there, seeking to discover the secrets held by the streets they were walking upon. It was there that I decided to link sketching with history, travelling and humour and create for them an edition of amusing illustrated tourist guides. In 2015 I published a book about my hometown, Walterin Bratislava.

 

To prop up this story with facts, I enclose my illustrated biography.

Introduction

Welcome to Walterin! We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share information about you when you visit our website (www.walterin.com) and purchase our products.

We believe in transparency - everything here is straightforward and honest, just like our comics.

1. Information We Collect

1.1 Information You Provide to Us

When you make a purchase or create an account, we collect:

  • Contact Information: Name, email address, phone number
  • Shipping Information: Delivery address
  • Payment Information: Payment card details (processed securely by our payment providers)
  • Account Information: Username, password (encrypted)
  • Communication Data: Messages you send us, reviews, feedback

1.2 Information We Collect Automatically

When you visit our website, we automatically collect:

  • Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device type, operating system
  • Usage Data: Pages visited, time spent on site, links clicked
  • Cookies: Small files stored on your device (see Section 7)

1.3 Information from Third Parties

We may receive information from:

  • Payment Processors: Transaction confirmation
  • Analytics Providers: Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel
  • Shipping Partners: Delivery status updates

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your personal data to:

2.1 Fulfill Orders

  • Process and deliver your purchases
  • Send order confirmations and shipping updates
  • Handle returns and refunds

2.2 Improve Our Service

  • Analyze website usage to improve user experience
  • Test new features and products
  • Fix technical issues

2.3 Marketing (with your consent)

  • Send newsletters about new products and updates
  • Show you relevant ads on social media
  • Offer special promotions

You can opt out of marketing anytime by clicking "unsubscribe" in any email or contacting us at support@walterin.com.

2.4 Legal Compliance

  • Comply with legal obligations (tax, accounting)
  • Prevent fraud and protect our rights
  • Respond to legal requests

3. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)

We process your data based on:

  • Contract Performance: To fulfill your order
  • Legitimate Interest: To improve our service and prevent fraud
  • Legal Obligation: To comply with tax and accounting laws
  • Consent: For marketing communications (you can withdraw anytime)

4. Who We Share Your Data With

We share your information only when necessary:

4.1 Service Providers

  • Payment Processors: Stripe, PayPal (for secure payments)
  • Shipping Companies: Packeta, DHL (for delivery)
  • Email Service: For sending order confirmations and newsletters
  • Hosting Provider: For website operation

4.2 Analytics & Marketing

  • Google Analytics: Website traffic analysis
  • Facebook Pixel: Ad targeting and performance
  • Google Ads: Advertising campaigns

4.3 Legal Requirements

We may disclose information if required by law or to protect our legal rights.

We never sell your personal data to third parties.

5. International Data Transfers

Your data may be transferred to and stored in countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA), including the United States, where our service providers operate.

We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place (Standard Contractual Clauses, adequacy decisions) to protect your data.

6. How Long We Keep Your Data

We retain your data for as long as necessary:

  • Order Information: 10 years (for tax and accounting purposes)
  • Account Information: Until you delete your account
  • Marketing Data: Until you unsubscribe
  • Technical Data: 26 months (Google Analytics default)

After this period, we securely delete or anonymize your data.

7. Cookies

We use cookies to:

  • Essential Cookies: Make the website work (shopping cart, login)
  • Analytics Cookies: Understand how you use our site (Google Analytics)
  • Marketing Cookies: Show you relevant ads (Facebook Pixel, Google Ads)

You can control cookies in your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.

For more details, see our Cookie Policy.

8. Your Rights (GDPR)

Under GDPR, you have the right to:

  • Access: Request a copy of your personal data
  • Rectification: Correct inaccurate information
  • Erasure: Delete your data ("right to be forgotten")
  • Restriction: Limit how we use your data
  • Portability: Receive your data in a structured format
  • Object: Opt out of marketing or data processing
  • Withdraw Consent: Stop processing based on consent

To exercise these rights, contact us at support@walterin.com.

Response Time: We'll respond within 30 days.

9. Data Security

We take security seriously:

  • SSL Encryption: All data transmitted is encrypted
  • Secure Payment Gateways: PCI-DSS compliant processors
  • Access Controls: Only authorized personnel can access data
  • Regular Backups: To prevent data loss

However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

10. Children's Privacy

Our website is not intended for children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe we've collected data from a child, please contact us immediately.

11. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices. Please review their privacy policies.

12. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Effective Date."

Continued use of our website after changes constitutes acceptance of the new policy.

13. Contact Us

Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact us:

Email: support@walterin.com
Mail: Walterin s.r.o., Ľubochnianska 4, 831 04 Bratislava, Slovak Republic
Phone: (available on request)

14. Supervisory Authority

If you're not satisfied with our response, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority:

Slovak Data Protection Authority (ÚOOÚ)
Website: www.dataprotection.gov.sk
Email: statny.dozor@pdp.gov.sk
